gross_floor_area_m2.notes: Sum of two reported buildings: 34,500 sqm and 40,000 sqm. Developer says floorspace is to be confirmed through a Planning Permission in Principle application.

current_land_use: Vacant cleared former industrial land; all former IBM buildings demolished (complete by September 2020, final demolition March 2022)
previous_land_use: IBM manufacturing campus (typewriters/office equipment, later personal computers and call centre), 1954 to 2016/17; site later branded Valley Park; served by dedicated IBM railway halt (1978-2018, services suspended)
land_notes: Large flat valley-floor brownfield strip extending c.2.1 km along the A78 Inverkip Road, south-west Greenock. Designated a 'Priority Place' in the Inverclyde Local Development Plan (developer statement). Coordinates are the valley/former-campus centroid from Wikipedia, not a red-line centroid — no application boundary has been published, so precision is 'approximate' and no boundary.geojson is provided. Reusable infrastructure: the site retains its cleared development platforms and the disused IBM rail halt (a park-and-ride reopening was part of the 2023 housing consent); no developer claim found about reusing former IBM power or fibre infrastructure.
